name: Individual Order Confirmation Status And Reason 3
definition: Status report of the individual orders confirmation that was previously received.

MasterReference.name: Master Reference
MasterReference.definition: Reference assigned to a set of orders or trades in order to link them together.

OrderReference.name: Order Reference
OrderReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for the order, as assigned by the instructing party.

Confirmation.name: Confirmation
Confirmation.definition: Status of the order confirmation cancellation.

ClientReference.name: Client Reference
ClientReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous investor's identification of an order. This reference can typically be used in a hub scenario to give the reference of the order as assigned by the underlying client.

DealReference.name: Deal Reference
DealReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for the order execution, as assigned by the confirming party.

NonceIdentification.name: Nonce Identification
NonceIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of a random or semi-random number used once (NONCE) generated in the frame of a cryptographic communication.

StatusInitiator.name: Status Initiator
StatusInitiator.definition: Party that initiates the status of the order confirmation.

InvestmentAccountDetails.name: Investment Account Details
InvestmentAccountDetails.definition: Account information of the individual order confirmation for which the status is given.

FinancialInstrumentDetails.name: Financial Instrument Details
FinancialInstrumentDetails.definition: Financial instrument information of the individual order confirmation for which the status is given.
